result.brief: 提出 EffectWAM：以未来观测与当前锚点的差异建模视觉变化（Effect），并用动作接地训练视觉表征，联合流匹配预测动作块与未来视频，用于机器人操作。
result.reason: World-action model with visual representation learning (Effect targets, action grounding of visual features) plus action-conditioned video prediction; main contribution is embodied policy/world model.
